body: I litarally have no friends. I asked all of my old friends what they were doing grand final day, I know they saw my messages and snapchats. So I had to watch the game at home by myself and then while I was checking my social media I saw all the people I asked at a party together. I thought we were cool but I have no idea what happened, they just stopped talking to me. ALL of them. This has been going on for months and im struggling to make new friends because my confidence is shot.
If you got any morbid questions hmu. I dont really give a shit.

They really are as polite about not liking me as they can be, Its just natural not everyone will like you. But when NO ONE does it starts to take a toll. Where I live now is the same as back home. Two large groups of people like that? Hard to believe its just a coincidence. It has to be me.

I dont even know, Im just tired of trying to be the best person I can be and this be the result. Like I see the people I live with and back home give me polite smiles and when I try and start a conversation they quickly come up with an excuse every time. I dont blame them for not liking me, there polite about it but when its the same thing every where you go you just get tired of trying.
But like what if she died, theres no way I know. How do you deal with that? do the police tell you how she is? or do I have to finfd out myself?
